A Good Way to Finish the Series Zup! F keeps the familiar formula that made me enjoy these little puzzle games so much. The addition of new cubes gives the levels a bit of extra variety, without changing what makes the experience so simple …
I only bought this for the achievement lettering that matches my galaxy theme, after an incredibly helpful friend recommended Zup! to me to enhance my Steam profile. …

You really want my thoughts on "Zup! F"? Let me tell you: Purple. Everywhere purple. Like glorp-juice on a sidewalk. It… it puzzle platformer or some bullsh*t. Not real. Squishy box jump on fake sky. FAKE. Spleen-fribble! Glibber-gork! …
本作取名F（Final=最终作），作者发售官宣本作是系列收官之作，后续依旧推出Z、Q、Y等多款续作，圈内诞生名梗：Zup的Final永远在下一部，每逢新作上线，玩家便调侃“又一部最终作落地”。
功能性益智小游戏，打折买的话把掉的卡卖了基本免费。
